narrative: The plot nailed by the door. Titus at two. His name stands beside an old Roman, and that line is already behind him. The fourth act is the next mark. The strip rolled in his hand. He is at the side of the stage, out of the light. He does not go on again.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the old Roman and did not return.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Shown on stage in Off in the fourth
